proposal.summary: The catalog invariant suite would assert the stored stock result and rejection of duplicate, negative, and fractional additions, covering the documented behavior currently called out by AGENTS.md but not asserted in the visible test body. This would give the existing CI test target behavioral evidence without duplicating suites. Validation scope covers those outcomes and failure propagation; restoration of the prior test body is the rollback.
proposal.title: Catalog invariant assertions

summary: The visible catalog test body calls add and stock but asserts no result or error behavior, while the guide and domain glossary identify duplicate, negative, and fractional stock as required behavior. CI is wired to this same test file; omitted tests remain unknown.
unverifiedChecks: Whether stored stock and duplicate, negative, and fractional input outcomes are asserted remains unverified.
Whether the existing CI test target reports these behavioral regressions remains unverified.
